meta.anchor_convention: GitHub-flavored-markdown slug (lowercase, punctuation stripped, spaces->hyphens, duplicates suffixed -1,-2...)
meta.line_numbers: 1-based, inclusive; line_end is subtree-inclusive (covers child sections)
notes: Anchors assume this file is rendered by a GFM-compatible renderer; verify against your host portal.

source='service-terms' (Part 4/Legal) was self-flagged in the canonical as reconstructed-from-paste pending byte-diff. RESOLVED 2026-07-08: byte-verified against the complete Apple source (Dec 17 2024); only deviations are the 2 documented [sic] annotations. See provenance.service-terms.verification_note.
source_stale=true (msp-onboarding, 2024) means uniquely-sourced facts need verification per the canonical's own rule (§37 R10).

catalogs.endpoints[].line is the exact 1-based location and is authoritative; section_title/anchor are the nearest enclosing heading. Because Apple renders some procedure titles (e.g. 'Downloading and Decrypting an Attachment') as bold prose rather than headings, an endpoint's nearest heading may be the preceding sibling — use line to locate the exact call.
catalogs.schemas[].anchor is the unique machine key; qualified_name is the human label (line marker appended where names collide).

gaps.topic: Managed Apple Account behavior in AMB
gaps.missing_detail: DOC 2.2 (Brand Onboarding) confirms a corporate Managed Apple Account may be used for AMB account login by the registering Business. **Still absent from any Apple source:** customer-side behavioral differences, restrictions, or enterprise admin controls specific to AMB for Managed accounts when used as the consumer-side Apple Account. Business-registration use is documented; consumer-side use is not.
Apple Integration Spec confirms bidirectional typing indicators (`typing_start`, `typing_end`) are Required (Sections 7 and 8). Previously unconfirmed in PASS A and PASS B.
Read receipts documented for iMessage person-to-person; no explicit AMB business-context documentation found on any Apple-owned source.

gaps.missing_detail: No Apple-authored rate limit table published in any source.

Service Terms §2.9 (DOC 3.1) contains a verbatim HIPAA exclusion: HIPAA-covered entities, business associates, or representatives **may not** use any component, function, or facility of AMB to create, receive, maintain, or transmit Protected Health Information (PHI) as defined at 45 C.F.R § 160.103, or use AMB in any manner that would make Apple (or any subsidiary) the Business's or any third party's business associate. **AMB is not approved for PHI by HIPAA-covered entities; Apple expressly refuses to be a business associate.** This is not "Apple is silent" — it is an explicit prohibition. See §35.3 for the verbatim text.
Not addressed in any Apple-authored source. ISO/IEC 27001 and 27018 confirmed (Section 28.3).

gaps.topic: v4.2.2 "Interactive message image type restrictions added"
gaps.missing_detail: The restriction is **size-based only** — not MIME-type-based. The `ImageItem` Dictionary (§12.5) already documented the applicable limits: ≤ 200 KB per individual image binary; ≤ 5 MB total for the `images` array. No PNG-only or MIME type constraint was added to `interactiveData.data.images`. The PNG-only rule exists only for the `ImageAsset` in Rich Link messages (§23.4), where it has always been explicit. No canonical changes required.

gaps.topic: v4.2 "Updated payload specifications for enhanced security"
gaps.missing_detail: Three concrete changes in the Authentication Message flow, all already documented in §17: (1) **Client secret removed from payload** — the new OAuth 2.0 flow (`AUTH2`) eliminates `clientSecret` from in-message transmission (§17.10; §17 deprecation note); (2) **`state` parameter now required for CSRF protection** — `state` is REQUIRED in §17.5 with explicit CSRF semantics; must be a unique cryptographically random session token; (3) **OAuth provider endpoints must present a valid Extended Validation (EV) certificate** — documented in §17.2. All three changes originated in v4.2 (11 February 2026). No canonical changes required.

Apple does not publish a numeric maximum item count for List Picker. This is confirmed as an architectural characteristic, not a documentation gap: Apple explicitly documents hard count limits when they exist (e.g., Quick Reply 2–5 items verbatim in Apple's MSP tutorial); no equivalent statement exists for List Picker in any Apple-indexed source. The operative Apple-level constraint is the 10-KB `interactiveData` payload threshold. See Section 14.4 note. MSP-level item count limits vary widely and are not Apple-spec requirements.

gaps.missing_detail: Documented in §28.3 (extended in v6.0). Wide logo: ≥256px height, ≤1706px width, ≤6.66:1 aspect ratio, transparent background, full-color artwork, sRGB or P3 color space, ≤2MB, PNG/JPEG. Square logo: ≥1024×1024px, full-color background, sRGB or P3 color space, ≤2MB, PNG/JPEG, no personal/product imagery. Business name: commercial name only — no location, no LLC/LTD/Inc., etc. Account types: online-only / single public location / multiple public locations.
